question: Should the distributed Oracle skill remove the personal 1Password key-reveal command entirely, or replace it with generic user-owned secret setup guidance?
rationale: This is credential-handling guidance in a user-copyable skill, so maintainer security intent should be explicit before a fix is queued.

options.title: Remove the personal steps
options.body: Delete the named 1Password item command and `~/Projects/oracle` checkout commands from the shipped skill, with any local workflow kept private.

options.title: Replace with generic guidance
options.body: Swap the personal command for neutral guidance that tells users to provide their own `OPENAI_API_KEY` without naming a vault item or reveal command.

options.title: Keep as maintainer-only guidance
options.body: Leave the content only if maintainers intentionally scope this skill to a private local environment rather than a distributed skill.

recommendation.title: Remove the personal steps
recommendation.body: Delete the named 1Password item command and `~/Projects/oracle` checkout commands from the shipped skill, with any local workflow kept private.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant skill and release history routes through `steipete`, and the decision concerns repository-owned credential guidance.
